# Trash API

6 endpoints. Request and response schemas are described on the [schemas page](schemas.md); the other tags are listed in the [API index](README.md).

## Endpoints

### `GET /api/v1/repositories/{name}/trash`

List a repository's trash

Soft-deleted items of one repository. Requires the repository-scoped delete permission; unknown or trashed repository: 404.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `kind` | query | string | no | Only items of this kind. One of: `repository`, `maven_artifact`, `ivy_artifact`, `sbt_artifact`, `npm_version`, `pypi_package`, `nuget_package`, `go_module`, `cargo_crate`, `rubygems_gem`, `conda_package`, `conan_package`, `helm_chart`, `raw_artifact`, `docker_manifest`, `docker_tag`, `rpm_package`, `deb_package`. |
| `page` | query | integer | no | Page number (default 1). Minimum: 1. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Items per page (default 50, max 200). Minimum: 1. Maximum: 200. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | A page of trashed items, newest deletion first | `application/json`: [TrashList](schemas.md#trashlist) |
| `403` | Delete permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/repositories/{name}/trash`

Empty a repository's trash

Permanently purges the trashed items of one repository now (blobs freed, quota released, audit artifact.purged and webhook events as for a single purge). Items only: neither the repository nor a trashed repository row is touched. Requires the repository-scoped manage permission (global administrators have it) or the maintainer or owner role in the repository's project. At most 1000 items are purged per request; `remaining` says how many are left, so repeat the call until it is 0.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | Items purged by this request and items still in the trash | `application/json`: [TrashEmpty](schemas.md#trashempty) |
| `403` | Manage permission on the repository required | - |
| `404` | Repository not found | - |

### `POST /api/v1/repositories/{name}/trash/{kind}/{id}/restore`

Restore an item of a repository

Like the admin restore, for callers with the repository-scoped delete permission. The item must belong to the repository; kind repository is admin only.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | - |
| `kind` | path | string | yes | One of the TrashItem kind values. One of: `repository`, `maven_artifact`, `ivy_artifact`, `sbt_artifact`, `npm_version`, `pypi_package`, `nuget_package`, `go_module`, `cargo_crate`, `rubygems_gem`, `conda_package`, `conan_package`, `helm_chart`, `raw_artifact`, `docker_manifest`, `docker_tag`, `rpm_package`, `deb_package`. |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Trash item id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The restored item | `application/json`: [TrashItem](schemas.md#trashitem) |
| `403` | Delete permission on the repository required (restoring a repository needs an admin) | - |
| `404` | Trash item not found (never deleted, already restored or purged, or not in this repository) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | trash_conflict: an item with the same name/version was published after the delete; delete or rename it first. repository_in_trash: the item's repository is in the trash; restore the repository first. manifest_in_trash: a docker tag's manifest is in the trash; restore the manifest first. | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `GET /api/v1/trash`

List the trash (admin)

Every soft-deleted package and repository, newest first.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | query | string | no | Only items of this kind. One of: `repository`, `maven_artifact`, `ivy_artifact`, `sbt_artifact`, `npm_version`, `pypi_package`, `nuget_package`, `go_module`, `cargo_crate`, `rubygems_gem`, `conda_package`, `conan_package`, `helm_chart`, `raw_artifact`, `docker_manifest`, `docker_tag`, `rpm_package`, `deb_package`. |
| `repository` | query | string | no | Only items of the repository with this name (a repository that is itself in the trash is not matched by name; its items are hidden). |
| `page` | query | integer | no | Page number (default 1). Minimum: 1. |
| `limit` | query | integer | no | Items per page (default 50, max 200). Minimum: 1. Maximum: 200. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | A page of trashed items, newest deletion first | `application/json`: [TrashList](schemas.md#trashlist) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |

### `DELETE /api/v1/trash/{kind}/{id}`

Purge a trashed item now (admin)

Permanently removes the item before its retention window ends: frees its blobs (a repository's are swept as orphans afterwards), releases quota and emits artifact.purged / repository.purged. Cannot be undone.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | path | string | yes | One of the TrashItem kind values. One of: `repository`, `maven_artifact`, `ivy_artifact`, `sbt_artifact`, `npm_version`, `pypi_package`, `nuget_package`, `go_module`, `cargo_crate`, `rubygems_gem`, `conda_package`, `conan_package`, `helm_chart`, `raw_artifact`, `docker_manifest`, `docker_tag`, `rpm_package`, `deb_package`. |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Trash item id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `204` | Purged | - |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Trash item not found | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | The repository is still referenced (for example by a release bundle or promotion) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |

### `POST /api/v1/trash/{kind}/{id}/restore`

Restore a trashed item or repository (admin)

Brings the item back, refreshes the repository's generated metadata and emits artifact.restored / repository.restored. Restoring into a name or version that was published meanwhile fails with 409 trash_conflict.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | path | string | yes | One of the TrashItem kind values. One of: `repository`, `maven_artifact`, `ivy_artifact`, `sbt_artifact`, `npm_version`, `pypi_package`, `nuget_package`, `go_module`, `cargo_crate`, `rubygems_gem`, `conda_package`, `conan_package`, `helm_chart`, `raw_artifact`, `docker_manifest`, `docker_tag`, `rpm_package`, `deb_package`. |
| `id` | path | string (uuid) | yes | Trash item id. |

**Responses**

| Status | Description | Body |
|---|---|---|
| `200` | The restored item | `application/json`: [TrashItem](schemas.md#trashitem) |
| `403` | Admin access required | - |
| `404` | Trash item not found (never deleted, already restored or purged, or not in this repository) | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
| `409` | trash_conflict: an item with the same name/version was published after the delete; delete or rename it first. repository_in_trash: the item's repository is in the trash; restore the repository first. manifest_in_trash: a docker tag's manifest is in the trash; restore the manifest first. | `application/json`: [Error](schemas.md#error) |
